content:
alex: Heads-up — builder image publish to staging-canary is failing since the last deploy, SBOM verification errors with 'missing attestation'. Anyone seen this?

mira: saw the CI alert. job 'sbom-verify' returned 422. Logs point to cosign lookup failing for the SBOM attestation. https://ci.internal/redwood/1234

sanjay: Any recent changes to the builder base image or tag pinning? We switched to a nightly base last week which could explain non-determinism.

mira: we changed the tag strategy to 'latest-nightly' in infra-builders Dockerfile — that lets the SS of the image float so SBOMs sometimes don't match the allowlist we maintain.

julie: Security prefers immutable digests for builder and bootstrap images. We should pin and ensure SBOMs + attestations are reproducible. Recommend cosign + in-toto.

alex: Proposed plan: (1) pin base builder image to digest in infra-builders repo; (2) CI emits SBOM + cosign attestation and uploads them as artifacts tied to the digest; (3) enforce digest references in GitOps manifests (ArgoCD).

mira: I'll change the CI. Current build snippet looks like:
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    steps:
      - docker build -t gcr.io/redwood-infra/builders:latest-nightly .
      - docker push gcr.io/redwood-infra/builders:latest-nightly
  sbom:
    steps:
      - syft gcr.io/redwood-infra/builders:latest-nightly -o cyclonedx-json=sbom.json
      - cosign sign-blob --key /secrets/cosign-key sbom.json --output-attestation sbom.intoto
      - curl -X PUT https://artifact-registry.internal/sboms/builders/latest-nightly -T sbom.json
```

mira: will switch to building, capturing the pushed digest, uploading SBOM/attestations under that digest, and emitting a metadata file with digest:sha256:abcd... for GitOps automation.

alex: Also add an ArgoCD image policy gate to reject non-digest refs. For canary we can add a temporary fallback: if SBOM verification fails, ArgoCD can allow a single rollback to the previous digest and open an alert.

julie: Agree. Also add a periodic scan job that compares installed packages across pinned digests (grype/syft) to detect drift over time. That helps catch hidden changes from base image updates.

sanjay: Note from runtime: our GPU node bootstrap uses these builder images for installing infra tools. If tags float, different nodes can boot with different envs -> production drift. Pinning to digest prevents that.

mira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra-builders/pull/720 - changes CI to push by digest, upload SBOM and attestations keyed by digest, and set SBOM_STRICT=true for prod but false for canary while we validate.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: automated check detected mismatch between GitOps manifests and registry digests for namespace 'infra-builders'.

alex: OK let's merge the PR and schedule a short maintenance window to update GitOps manifests to digest references and then redeploy infra-builders. I'll coordinate with release engineering to prevent noisy rollouts.

julie: One more ask: add an SBOM retention/expiration policy (e.g., 30 days for nightly) and a cleanup job to avoid unbounded artifact storage costs.

mira: noted — will add cleanup and a tagging policy to the PR. Also will include a small job to verify attestation signatures using our KMS-backed cosign key.

sanjay: thanks. I'll monitor node bootstraps and bootstrap logs. If we still see drift, we should consider node-level immutable snapshots for critical infra images.

alex: Closing the loop: once merged we require digest refs in git, enforce cosign attestations in CI/ArgoCD, and add a rollback workflow for canary failures. I'll post an update in #eng-infra when done.

mira: :thumbsup:

julie: :lock:
